records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#19
records.source: The profile is the default for one reason that outweighs its cost: **the Wald interval is finite by construction.** It is ``L ± t·SE``, so it returns a tidy, symmetric, entirely fictional interval for a curve whose midpoint the data does not locate at all — which is exactly the case this module exists to catch. The profile interval can *fail to close*: the residual sum of squares stays under the threshold all the way out to a concentration ten thousand times the highest dose tested, and that failure is the diagnostic. It is reported as an open bound, not smoothed into a number.

The profile interval can *fail to close*: the residual sum of squares stays under the threshold all the way out to a concentration ten thousand times the highest dose tested, and that failure is the diagnostic. It is reported as an open bound, not smoothed into a number.
records.translation: Prófílbil er sjálfgefið af einni ástæðu sem vegur þyngra en kostnaðurinn: **Wald-bilið er endanlegt samkvæmt skilgreiningu.** Það er ``L ± t·SE`` og skilar því snyrtilegu, samhverfu en algerlega ímynduðu bili fyrir feril sem gögnin staðsetja alls ekki miðpunktinn á — einmitt tilvikið sem þessi eining á að greina. Prófílbilið getur *ekki lokast*: summa kvaðratleifa helst undir þröskuldinum allt að styrk sem er tíu þúsund sinnum hæsti prófaði skammtur, og sú bilun er sjálf greiningarniðurstaðan. Hún er birt sem opin mörk en ekki sléttuð yfir í tölu.

records.label: spacr.report#7
records.source: **Nothing is recomputed.** Every number here was produced by the pipeline and read back off disk. The one exception is deliberate and narrow: the segmentation scorecard CSV is re-fed to :func:`spacr.seg_qc.summarize_qc`, the same function that printed the verdict at run time, so the plate verdict in the report is the verdict spaCR gave — not a second opinion. No p-value, no effect size and no aggregate statistic is invented by this module. Where a check exists but has to be run on demand (plate edge effects, inter-annotator κ), the report says so and names the tool.

Ef athugun er til en þarf að keyra sérstaklega, svo sem jaðaráhrif örplötu eða κ milli merkjara, segir skýrslan það og nefnir verkfærið.

records.source: **RAM cap + temp spill** — the 100 most-recent figures keep their full-resolution QPixmap in RAM. When figure #101 arrives, figure #1's pixmap is dropped from RAM (its PNG stays on disk in a temp dir); #102 evicts #2, and so on — a 100-wide sliding window. Navigating back to an evicted figure reloads it from its temp PNG on demand.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#96
records.source: Four candidate themes were cut on the same kind of numbers rather than shipped slow — a mesh lattice (3.2–8.1 ms), contour polylines (10.8 ms), a linked constellation and a branching mycelium (5.7–8.2 ms; see the theme list above). All four are crisp line work, and in Qt's raster engine a translucent antialiased line costs an order of magnitude more than the same pixels as a gradient — a vertical line is a thousand one-pixel spans. Painting them into the small buffer instead makes them cheap and also makes them not lines any more. The rule that fell out: *soft is cheap, crisp is expensive*, and ``drift`` is crisp only because a couple of hundred dots light 0.65 % of the page.
records.context: Four candidate themes were cut on the same kind of numbers rather than shipped slow — a mesh lattice (3.2–8.1 ms), contour polylines (10.8 ms), a linked constellation and a branching mycelium (5.7–8.2 ms; see the theme list above). All four are crisp line work, and in Qt's raster engine a translucent antialiased line costs an order of magnitude more than the same pixels as a gradient — a vertical line is a thousand one-pixel spans. Painting them into the small buffer instead makes them cheap and also makes them not lines any more. The rule that fell out: *soft is cheap, crisp is expensive*, and ``drift`` is crisp only because a couple of hundred dots light 0.65 % of the page.
records.translation: Fjórum mögulegum þemum var hafnað á grundvelli sambærilegra mælinga í stað þess að afhenda þau hæg: möskvanet (3,2–8,1 ms), útlínufjöllínur (10,8 ms), tengt stjörnumerki og greinótt sveppþráðanet (5,7–8,2 ms; sjá þemalistann að ofan). Öll fjögur eru skörp línuvinna og í rastervél Qt kostar hálfgegnsæ, afjöðruð lína stærðargráðu meira en sömu pixlar sem litstigull; lóðrétt lína er þúsund eins pixils spönn. Ef þau eru máluð í litla biðminnið verða þau ódýr en hætta líka að vera línur. Reglan varð: *mjúkt er ódýrt, skarpt er dýrt*, og ``drift`` er aðeins skarpt vegna þess að nokkur hundruð punktar lýsa 0,65 % síðunnar.

records.label: spacr.training_basis#4
records.source: **Backward compatibility is the whole difficulty.** A settings CSV written before this exists in every user's project folder, and INVARIANTS §6 is the trap: a key *absent* from the dict means the pipeline falls back to its own default, which can differ from the GUI's, and nothing says so. Every rename here is therefore an alias, not a replacement — :func:`normalize_settings` translates the old name and the old *implicit* basis into the new explicit one, and a run from an old CSV does exactly what it did before.
records.context: **Backward compatibility is the whole difficulty.** A settings CSV written before this exists in every user's project folder, and INVARIANTS §6 is the trap: a structured-data name *absent* from the key-value mapping means the workflow falls back to its own default, which can differ from the GUI's, and nothing says so. Every rename here is therefore an alias, not a replacement — :func:`normalize_settings` translates the old name and the old *implicit* basis into the new explicit one, and a processing session from an old CSV does exactly what it did before.
records.translation: **Afturvirk samhæfni er allur vandinn.** Stillinga-CSV frá því áður en þetta var til er í verkefnamöppu hvers notanda, og INVARIANTS §6 er gildran: ef lykil *vantar* í vörpunina notar vinnslurásin sitt eigið sjálfgefna gildi, sem getur verið annað en sjálfgefið gildi GUI, án viðvörunar. Hvert endurnefni hér er því samheiti en ekki staðgengill — :func:`normalize_settings` þýðir gamla heitið og gamla *óskráða* grunninn yfir í nýja skýra grunninn, svo keyrsla úr gömlu CSV hagar sér nákvæmlega eins og áður.

records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#10
records.source: **Statistics use the well as the unit of replication.** Parasites within a well share a coverslip, an antibody bath and a focal plane, so they are not independent; the reported test is a Mann-Whitney U on the per-well efficiencies. A pooled-parasite chi-squared is reported beside it purely so its inflation is visible. See :func:`_invasion_compare_conditions`.
records.context: **Statistics use the microplate sample position as the unit of replication.** Parasites within a microplate sample position share a coverslip, an antibody bath and a focal image layer, so they are not independent; the reported test is a Mann-Whitney U on the per-microplate sample position efficiencies. A pooled-parasite chi-squared is reported beside it purely so its inflation is visible. See :func:`_invasion_compare_conditions`.
records.translation: **Tölfræðin notar sýnisstöðuna sem endurtekningareiningu.** Sýklar í sömu sýnisstöðu deila þekjugleri, mótefnabaði og fókusmyndlagi og eru því ekki óháðir. Birta prófið er Mann–Whitney U-próf á skilvirkni hverrar sýnisstöðu. Kí-kvaðratpróf á öllum sameinuðum sýklum er birt við hlið þess eingöngu svo sjáist hve ýkt niðurstaða þess er. Sjá :func:`_invasion_compare_conditions`.
